summary: Defines the protocol for the L4S network service. It uses an Explicit Congestion Notification scheme at the IP layer that is similar to classic ECN but gives much more frequent signals, matched to scalable congestion control. It is an experimental specification.

eli5.summary: Routers can put a small mark on packets saying getting crowded. L4S uses lots of tiny marks, so senders adjust gently and quickly.
